Proves AR-6's generic `neq` operator against a `boolean` field, with SEM-2's null-inclusion rule applying identically to booleans as to any other type (`<> :v OR IS NULL`). As with case 005, no native AG Grid wire shape reaches generic `neq` for a boolean column (only the set-filter shorthand -> unary `true`/`false`), so this fixture uses the `customFilters` extension point — see the category README.
